notes: Strict-mode tilt totals (strict:tilt_max, strict:cr_tilt_max) are not exported in this release (null, mass fraction 0 in every totals file, training-clock and extra files included): the grid was computed while the endpoint-plane tilt rule meant for thick mode was applied in strict mode too, dropping strict mode's held-out prediction gate; the library now keeps that gate in strict mode (mm/step.py, rule 'tilt_angles'). Strict tilt coverage under the correct rule is near zero (e.g. 14 images at checkpoint 15, b5->b6). Thick-mode tilt (thick:tilt_max, per-point field 'tilt') is unaffected.
JSON files contain no NaN/Infinity literals: undefined values are null, with mass_fraction 0 for totals.
